idea: Routines & independence #1 – tidy up (AVA'S ROOM): the lid of Baby Ava's pink toy box pops open and her red ball, yellow duck and blue toy car tumble out onto the rug ('Oh no! Oh no! What a mess!'); chorus 'Tidy up, tidy up! Toys go in the box!'; she puts them back one by one – 'Red ball, in the box! Plop!', 'Yellow duck, in the box! Plop!', 'Blue car, in the box! Plop!'; copy-me 'Pick it up! Put it in! Do it with me!' with claps; she asks the viewer 'Where do toys go? Hmm?' – 'In the box! Yay! All tidy!'; lesson 'I can tidy up all by myself!'. Loop: the hook framing again, now the box is closed and the rug tidy, bye-bye wave.
title: Oh No! What a Mess! 🧸 Tidy Up Song with Baby Ava | Clean Up for Toddlers | Crayon Babies
description:
Oh no! Baby Ava's toy box pops open and her toys tumble out all over the rug! 🧸 Sing along as Ava tidies up all by herself: the red ball, the yellow duck and the blue car go back in the box!

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Oh no! What a mess!" – the toys tumble out of the toy box
🎵 Tidy up, tidy up! Toys go in the box!
🔴 Red ball, in the box! Plop!
🦆 Yellow duck, in the box! Plop!
🚙 Blue car, in the box! Plop!
👐 Pick it up, put it in – do it with Ava!
🤔 "Where do toys go?" – can you answer?
👋 All tidy! Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: tidying up by myself • toys go back in the toy box • English words: tidy up, in the box, ball, duck, car • colors: red, yellow, blue

A fun sing-along clean-up cartoon for toddlers and preschoolers about putting toys away all by yourself, with Baby Ava in her cozy bedroom.
